svg.text: Design question: how does the agent know which tool result answers which tool call?
That's how each result finds its call.
Filled ◆ = owns it. Delete the Agent and
Hollow ◇ = uses it. Tools live on their own
and can be shared by many agents.
An assistant Message can ask for many
ToolCalls. A tool Message carries one
Left out on purpose: tokens, cost, retries,
